queries_run: Autoliv China tariff OR trade restriction 2026 third quarter results tariff

findings.claim: FY2025：2025年新關稅未對獲利造成重大衝擊，客戶補償超過80%的關稅成本；含回收稀釋效應，營業利益率約受-20bps影響；2026年指引假設關稅與貿易限制較2026-01-23生效狀態無重大變動。
findings.excerpt: The effects of the new tariffs imposed in 2025 did not have a significant impact on our profitability in 2025, as we achieved customer compensations for more than 80% of tariff costs. Including the dilutive effect of recovered tariffs, operating margin was negatively impacted by around 20 bps.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K風險因子：半導體與感測器採購依賴全球電子供應鏈，受出口管制、實體清單限制與制裁影響；關稅成本在固定價或終身定價合約下可能無法完全轉嫁。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Semiconductor and sensor sourcing relies heavily on global electronics supply chains, which are increasingly affected by export controls, entity‑list restrictions, and sanctions targeting technology supply routes.

findings.claim: Q3 2026 10-Q：客戶補償超過80%關稅成本，淨負面影響約$6M；全年關稅對營業利益率稀釋預計與2025年相近約20bps。
findings.excerpt: We achieved customer compensation for more than 80% of the tariff costs, resulting in a net negative impact after compensation of around $6 million, in line with the net impact in the third quarter of 2025.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 10-Q：被最高法院推翻之IEEPA關稅，ALV毛曝險約$25M、淨曝險遠低於$10M；Q2回收淨正面約$3M。
findings.excerpt: Supreme Court's ruling that the International Emergency Economic Powers Act did not authorize the imposition of the tariffs in 2025, as our gross exposure is limited to around $25 million and the net exposure is well below $10 million.

findings.claim: RBC：管理層表示Section 232金屬修訂對Autoliv關稅狀況無重大影響。
findings.excerpt: Management also clarified that the section 232 revision on metals does not meaningfully impact Autoliv's tariff position, the note added. RBC said Autoliv is the best quality auto supplier in its coverage, given its market position and product offering versus competitors.
